551:t_021:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But the fact is, they aren't here...」

551:t_021:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That unlikely possibility is the only explanation I can think of.」

551:t_021:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$ must have teleported somewhere along with the entire system.」

551:t_022:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain! Director $$大塚$$ of the Far East branch has contacted us!」

551:t_022:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「He reports that forces believed to be $$アマルガム$$ suddenly appeared in the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$!」

551:t_022:3.en:
$n
「They're at the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$...」

551:t_022:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$ and $$レナード$$ are there...」

551:t_022:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Contact the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$ラー・カイラム$$! $c will regroup at $$相模湾$$!」

551:t_022:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「From there, we will head to the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$ and stop $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s ambitions!」

551:t_023:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「How was that, Sis!? Our teamwork was perfect, right!?」

551:t_023:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We're united in body and soul even on the battlefield!」

551:t_023:3.en:
$$マオ$$
(I'm acting like a young girl... Now I've started to treasure my life again...)

551:t_023:4.en:
$$マオ$$
(If that idiot is alive, I want to live in this world too...)

551:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
($$クルツ$$, Lieutenant $$サックス$$... Watch us...)

551:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(We'll do it, without fail...! We won't let him do whatever he wants with this world!)

551:t_101:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Something has felt wrong for a while now...)

551:t_101:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(What is this...? Am I... overlooking something...?)

551:t_102:1.en:
$$マオ$$
(A world without you means nothing... So I'll fight... prepared to throw away my life here...!)

551:t_103:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
($$ウェーバー$$... As your superior, I am responsible for losing you...)

551:t_103:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(Let's do this...! Sorry, but we'll win without fail, just to disappoint you!)
